children: Eagers Automotive's maiden foray into the U.S. auto retail market catches Jefferies by surprise. That's because Jefferies had expected Eagers would first seek to consolidate its position in Canada following its investment in CanadaOne Auto. Eagers Tuesday said it has agreed to buy a multi-franchise dealership group in California alongside CanadaOne founder Pat Priestner. Despite the unexpected nature of this move, analyst John Campbell is upbeat about the deal. The U.S. auto retail market is fragmented. Lithia, the biggest dealer, has only a 2.5% share. Also, the market is protected from Chinese automakers. "It appeals for these reasons," Jefferies says. It has a buy call and A$25.00/share price target on Eagers, which is up 0.1% at A$14.60.
